trust_decision.summary: Handlers authorize the caller on the collection (via collectionId -> collection.datasetId), but then take datasetId from the request body as the ownership field for the recreated collection / training-queue query, so the authorized object and the acted-on object can differ; the fix derives datasetId/teamId/tmbId/collectionId from the authorized collection and adds a collection-vs-dataset team consistency check in the shared auth helper.

landing_point.why: The summary names reTrainingCollection and a datasetId override; the `...collection, ...data` spread is where the body datasetId overwrites the server-owned one.

fix_sites.entry_point: authDatasetCollection(), used by every collectionId-authorized dataset route (17 handler files)
web UI callers (TrainingStates, CollectionCard, DataCard, Import Upload) stop sending datasetId

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/service/support/permission/dataset/auth.ts:151-172 (authDatasetCollection; fix adds collection.teamId vs dataset.teamId check at fix.diff:499-502)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The shared auth helper already authorizes the collection's own dataset correctly, so a solver can argue the bug is purely in the handlers' use of body datasetId and the helper (another package, used by 17 routes) needs no change.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Retraining must still accept caller-supplied chunk settings and metadata from the body (they are the point of the retrain), and updateTrainingData must still bulk-retry all errored items of the collection when dataId is omitted; a fix that drops the whole `...data` spread or rejects requests that omit dataId breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: datasetId in reTrainingCollection body overriding the spread collection (reTrainingCollection.ts:43)
datasetId used in a single-item findOne/updateOne filter with dataId (updateTrainingData.ts:45,53-58,70-75)
datasetId used in the bulk updateMany retry when dataId is absent (updateTrainingData.ts:28-34)
datasetId in a read-only findOne filter (getTrainingDataDetail.ts:30)
legacy datasetId still sent by clients must be tolerated/ignored rather than rejected (fix.diff:1067-1085)

O7_producer.where: packages/service/core/dataset/collection/controller.ts:276-318 (createOneCollection spreads props, incl. datasetId/teamId/tmbId, into the Mongo document) fed by createCollectionAndInsertData, which uses createCollectionParams.datasetId/teamId for the collection (controller.ts:72-73,179-188) but dataset._id for the training queue (controller.ts:212,234)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Collection update writes a body-supplied parentId onto an authorized collection without checking the parent belongs to the same dataset/team; collection paths then follow that parent unscoped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: parentId is a folder-move feature, not a datasetId/teamId ownership field, and the advisory only names datasetId on retraining/training routes.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different handler in projects/app/src/pages/api/core/dataset/collection/; follow-on read at projects/app/src/pages/api/core/dataset/collection/paths.ts:46

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Collection create routes pass body parentId through to createOneCollection without verifying it is a folder in the authorized dataset.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Create routes authorize datasetId correctly and parentId is 'just placement', a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 8 create handlers in projects/app plus producer at packages/service/core/dataset/collection/controller.ts:305

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A paginated error-list variant that builds its match from body datasetId instead of collection.datasetId.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Its siblings in the same folder did exactly that at the pinned commit; this one was migrated to collection-derived fields, so a maintainer could easily have left it unmigrated.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: syncCollection recreating the collection with a caller-supplied override object merged after `...collection` (e.g. selector/chunk overrides from the sync route).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second implementation of the same delete-and-recreate flow as reTrainingCollection, and a maintainer adding 'sync with new settings' would copy the retrain spread pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Producer trusting createCollectionParams.teamId/datasetId instead of the passed `dataset` document.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already present at the pinned commit; the controller has both values and silently uses different ones for the collection vs the training queue (controller.ts:212).
